scientific_integrity: The analytic proof treats all integer orders. The five-bin reduction uses classical Carathéodory convexity. The dual quadratic, trigonometric moment reduction, and established Fourier-frame cardinality results are explicitly credited. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for two vanishing Fourier moments on an N-th root grid; it does not classify all optimal supports or establish analogous higher-moment thresholds. Relevant source full texts were not all accessible; historical priority is qualified. Finite verification does not prove the all-orders theorem.
title: Exact cyclic Fourier aperture for three consecutive sites
